stacks_note: Reference = the repo's own CI gate at its base (mise run ci / ci.yml), split into suite (tests, run twice) and gate (lint/typecheck/build, run once), with CI's env vars. proxima-api adds PGSSLMODE=disable: CI's service Postgres has no SSL either, and asyncpg's default 'prefer' handshake through Docker Desktop's port proxy dropped 1 random connection per ~13k-test run ("rejected SSL upgrade", no server-side error). Generated API clients are gitignored (storefront gen:api, admin orval via its pretest hook, both from the in-repo contracts/openapi.json), so setup runs the codegen that the repo's own scripts would run. Rerun with PGSSLMODE=disable (obs-cors): still 1 random connection error in 1 of 2 runs (now TimeoutError), so it is a Docker Desktop connection flake, not SSL. Accepted as documented environment noise: a test counts as broken only if it also fails in 2 isolated reruns (CRIBA §6), which this flake never does.
